## Football effect

Hoskins finished the game as the record holds it: the injury was logged at the end of Cousins's second-quarter touchdown drive with no removal, and he played Cousins's field-goal drive, Henne's, Wilson's and Shaw's possessions (the 6-yard shift-to-Empty Spacing catch, the 7-yard Snag catch for a first down, the 1-yard catches on third-and-12 and fourth-and-14) and three kicking-game snaps. The instruction after the game is out, and on the projection he misses the Week 1 preparation and the first two games; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. His four-game receiving evidence (eight catches for 84 at Detroit, five for 13 here) stands as recorded; TE3 remains unfilled and is not decided by the instruction, and his roster disposition, if any, is Caldwell's with the user at the August 30 reduction. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
